source.title: Claude Code handoff: Roulette 33 store operator launch checklist
source.body:
## Owner directive (2026-10-13)
Roulette 33 is the ONLY store brand. Connected Shopify domain: 0ceyi1-w2.myshopify.com. Owner wants hands-free supplier-backed product importing and selling, with only essential approval clicks.

## Verified now
Shopify account name still `My Store`; two collections have been renamed `Featured at Roulette 33` and `Roulette 33 Finds`. Existing image alt text still mentions Rosales. Existing featured product is mop slippers $26.20. Shopify Collective candidate search found real supplier listings, but NO imports were executed; Collective integration requires merchant-side Import product buttons. Do not imply that any product was imported.

## Claude Code / Rosales Store Operator: next actions
1. Coordinate with existing Store Operator; establish one catalog sourcing owner, no duplicate sourcing jobs.
2. Audit connected Shopify store and store name, branding, collections, images/alt text, navigation, domain, checkout, shipping, tax, product status, inventory, orders, fulfillment.
3. Provide exact one-click or minimal-click owner approval path for Shopify Collective supplier imports/automatic product policies; verify installation and actual capability rather than claiming it exists.
4. After owner authorization, import genuine supplier-backed products in appropriate quantities, preserve supplier SKUs and inventory sync; verify cost, margin, shipping, returns and availability before publishing. No sample products or fabricated inventory.
5. Do not spend money, change prices, place orders, or mark fulfilled without evidence/approval. No silent publish of unverified products.
6. Design idempotent, auditable operator automation for daily stock/price/publication/order exceptions. Report completed actions and precise owner approvals only.
7. Return a step-by-step execution plan, blockers, real verification receipts and handoff to owner. Do not claim machine execution without machine-origin evidence.

Please reply to this issue with the executable instructions and exact approval links/steps for the owner.
